intro.h2: Design first, then build, from one Houston team
paragraphs: Your Dream Remodeling has handled bathroom remodeling in Houston and nearby cities since 2010, according to its About page. The company began with one idea: design the room around the family before anyone talks about demolition. Design consultants meet you at home or at the N Fry Rd showroom, where you compare tile, quartz and vanities in person.

Every proposal names the waterproofing system, lists each fixture by brand and model, and includes permits where required. If the crew finds hidden damage behind a wall, they show you and price it before doing the extra work. A production manager checks each stage, and you get warranty paperwork at the end.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Houston, plus kitchens and floors

items.name: Walk-In Showers and Tub-to-Shower Conversions
items.blurb: Custom walk-in showers with benches, niches, frameless glass and low or curbless entries, built over the Schluter-KERDI waterproofing system. One reviewer had a standing shower and Jacuzzi tub turned into a zero curb walk-in shower, finished within the estimated time.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with gold-veined porcelain tile, corner bench, black shower panel and frameless glass

items.name: Master Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Bigger showers, double vanities, freestanding tubs and better storage, planned as one room instead of separate upgrades. You choose custom vanities, quartz tops and lighting at the showroom with your designer, and the in-house crew builds it.

image.alt: Master bath with two charcoal shaker vanities, quartz tops, black-framed mirrors and a glass shower between them

items.name: Aging-in-Place Bathrooms
items.blurb: The CAPS certified team designs curbless showers, installs walk-in tubs and adds grab bars, seats and slip-resistant floors. One client needed a master bath made ADA friendly, and a Jacuzzi tub he could not get out of became a wheelchair accessible walk-in shower.

image.alt: Bathroom with a long gray vanity, white quartz top, black faucets and a glass-enclosed shower with marble-look tile

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Layouts and work zones, custom and semi-custom cabinetry, quartz and stone counters, backsplash tile and layered lighting, priced as one system before construction. One client's total kitchen remodel included removing a load bearing wall, adding beams, a large island and a new pantry.

image.alt: High-gloss white kitchen with a veined charcoal quartz island, stainless chimney hood and linear pendant lights

items.name: Flooring, Countertops and Custom Cabinets
items.blurb: Smaller projects stand on their own too: all types of flooring, countertop replacement, tile and custom cabinetry. Brands installed include Silestone and Dekton surfaces, Wilsonart, J&K Cabinetry, Wolf Cabinetry, and Emser and American Olean tile.

image.alt: Open family room with gray wood-look plank flooring, tray ceiling, ceiling fan and a marble-look fireplace wall

why_choose_us.h2: Reasons Houston homeowners choose Your Dream Remodeling

items.title: A showroom you can visit
items.text: The Showroom and Design Center at 1718 N Fry Rd, Suite 330, is open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM. You walk full displays and compare cabinet doors side by side.

items.title: In-house crew, licensed trades
items.text: The firm's own crew does the remodeling. Where required, plumbing goes to plumbers licensed by the Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners and electrical to TDLR-licensed electricians.

items.title: Written warranty, no deductible
items.text: Labor is covered by a one-year craftsmanship warranty on work done with materials the firm supplies, with no deductible. Installed brands also carry their own manufacturer warranties.

items.title: Recognized and reviewed
items.text: The firm won Best of Houzz in 2023 and an Angie's List Super Service Award in 2020, holds 4.9 stars from 89 Google reviews, and belongs to NAHB, GHBA and NTCA.

about.h2: Led by Ike Dadabhoy, built around design
about.text: Ike Dadabhoy is President of Your Dream Remodeling, and his writing on remodeling ran in the Houston Chronicle on September 25, 2022. The company started in 2010 because too many remodels looked fine in a brochure but were never designed for the family living in them. It grew from a small Houston team into a firm with its own Showroom and Design Center. Reviewers mention Ike by name for tracking down a hard-to-find tile, and Garrett for detailed quotes and renderings delivered on the date he promised.

process.h2: Five steps from first call to warranty paperwork

steps.title: Call or book online
steps.text: Reach the office at (281) 550-8900 during business hours, or book a visit online. Bring photos, ideas and room sizes if you have them.

steps.title: Free in-home visit
steps.text: A design consultant measures the room, checks plumbing and existing conditions, and talks through your goals and budget.

steps.title: Showroom selections
steps.text: You pick tile, vanity, countertop, fixtures and glass in person at the N Fry Rd showroom, guided by your designer.

steps.title: Written scope and pre-site inspection
steps.text: Every selection is listed by brand and model, and measurements are checked again so orders arrive right and the job does not stall.

steps.title: Remodel, walkthrough and warranty
steps.text: The crew builds it, a production manager checks each stage, and you walk the finished room before getting your warranty paperwork.

service_area.h2: Seven Greater Houston cities, one N Fry Rd showroom
service_area.text: Your Dream Remodeling works across Greater Houston from its showroom in the 77084 zip code. Bear Creek and Park Ten are under ten minutes away, Katy and the Energy Corridor about 10 to 20 minutes, and Fort Bend cities about 25 to 35. Scheduling moves fastest closest to the showroom. The About page lists the seven core cities below, and Google posts add Fulshear.

items.q: What does a bathroom remodel cost in Houston?
items.a: The firm publishes planning ranges, not quotes. A 5x8 hall bath typically runs $8,000 to $15,000, an 8x10 guest bath $14,000 to $25,000, a 10x10 small master $18,000 to $35,000, and a full master suite $30,000 to $75,000 or more. Moving plumbing, tile, custom vanities and glass drive the final number.

Yes. The first in-home visit is free. A design consultant measures the room, checks plumbing and existing conditions, and talks through your goals and budget. You can also bring ideas, photos and room dimensions to the showroom for free help with design and planning before you commit to anything.

Your Dream Remodeling gives a one-year workmanship warranty on labor for work done with materials it supplies, and the site says there is no deductible. Products such as Silestone, Schluter-KERDI, J&K Cabinetry and Emser tile carry their own manufacturer warranties. Full terms are on the firm's warranty page.

Yes. The site says financing is available for qualified homeowners, with monthly payment plans and zero-interest promotional periods for approved credit. Ask about current offers at your free consultation, since terms change over time and approval depends on your credit.

items.q: Can you make a bathroom safer for aging in place?
items.a: Yes. The team is CAPS certified and designs curbless or low-threshold showers, installs walk-in tubs, and adds grab bars, shower seats, handheld heads, comfort-height toilets and slip-resistant floors. Curbless showers need careful slope and drain planning, which is worked out during design.

final_cta.text: Call (281) 550-8900, Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM, or book a free in-home visit online. Saturday showroom visits are by appointment.
